sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Hand-painted outlined 2D game character model sheet. Image1 panel7 Brambleguard heavy enemy example defines detailed identity ONLY. Ignore other chars/text/scenery. Image2 defines heavy tall silhouette and 2.2tile scale only, not flat rendering. Brambleguard: bulky forest guardian, massive brown bark and cool-gray stone armor plates, moss and small leaf clusters at shoulders/head, thick gnarled root arms ending huge fists, two powerful root legs, small dark inset eyes under woody brow, ONE bright BLUE diamond crystal core recessed center chest with cool cyan rim. No weapons, no clothes. Keep it distinct from stone-temple boss. Four-view model proposal, FOUR full-body views in a single horizontal row of four equal cells: front, right profile, back, three-quarter-right. Landscape canvas, each view fully isolated with ample empty padding. No labels or text. Four equal horizontal cells, all views same scale. Genuine transparent background, opaque character, no floor, shadow, halo, scenery, borders, labels or text. Every root branch fits inside its cell with 60px padding.
